title: The Scientific Method-Richard Feynman
summary: A one-minute clip of Richard Feynman describing the scientific method: guess a law, compute its consequences, and compare with experiment. If it disagrees with experiment, it is wrong.
why: HN quotes it as the crispest statement of what science is, usually when a theory clashes with evidence.

quote.text: That is the scientific method. And it is presented by one of our best ever thinkers.
